items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh no, I knew Sam. ... Cause he was a…he used to teach Charlie Persip. And Charlie Persip, we used to hang out a lot together, and he’d always talking about Sam.

ctx.x: Yeah you wouldn’t want to get excited if you had the pistol! (Laughs) I also heard that Sam Woodyard used to keep a hammer and a gun on the bandstand. Is that pretty common?

Well I know why he had the hammer cause the drums, he’d have to nail ‘em down sometimes. The drums, they’d be bouncing all over the place. But I don’t know if the gun is for himself! (Laughs) Sam is crazy!
Again so you have—was that common for some musicians, or for people to have a gun? Why did you have to carry a gun?
